0022600038.text: The Pelicans (4-8, 12th in the West) host the Grizzlies (7-4, 9th in the West) in NBA Cup West Group B play, with New Orleans on a four-game losing streak and 1-4 on the road, while Memphis is 5-0 away from home but has lost its most recent game. The teams' 2026-27 season series is tied at 1-0 in New Orleans' favor after the Pelicans won 135-134 in Memphis on November 2, and they split their four meetings in 2025-26 at 2-2. Missing for New Orleans are Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Memphis will be without Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness).
